What data security certifications do you hold?
We are SOC-2 Type II certified and ISO 27001 compliant. All data at rest is encrypted using AES-256.
Do you offer discounts for non-profit organizations?
Yes! Registered 501(c)(3) charities and educational institutions receive a 50% discount on all plans.
